newsitem.title: USA: Exxon takes Louisiana coker into turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Exxon takes Louisiana coker into turnaround.

text.p: Exxon Corp said it took a 33,000 barrel per day (bpd) coking unit into planned maintenance at its Baton Rouge, Louisiana refinery Saturday.
A company spokesman would not comment on the projected restart date of the unit. The refinery has a total crude distillation capacity of 193,500 bpd, with cracking capacity of 205,000 bpd
A 73,000 bpd crude unit and 68,000 bpd reformer unit were taken into turnaround at the refinery on January 10 and 11, though no restart dates for those units have been announced.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
